title: Independent Research: Emergent Communication - Complex Deception (Adaptive Deceiver - Tuned Env)
abstract: This submission refines the 'Emergent Communication - Complex Deception' research by tuning the environment's collective punishment threshold. The 'threshold_for_collective_punishment_ratio' is increased to provide more leeway for justified defection against the adaptive deceiver without inadvertently penalizing the entire cooperative group. Cooperative agents retain their robust isolation strategy. This experiment aims to observe if collective well-being can be maintained among honest agents while effectively neutralizing a sophisticated, adapting adversary, allowing the full benefits of robust isolation to manifest. The simulation runs for an increased number of rounds (100).
